summary: Iteration 40 tested the requested admin alerts/partial credit, DB manager API/UI, Discord manager API/UI, NOWPayments webhook signature, TikTok debug probe, and Auto-Live copy against the public URL. Backend focused suite passed 6/6 with persistence and cleanup. Most frontend flows passed. Two DB manager security/auth defects remain: the visible owner credential login rejects the documented owner credentials, and the generic users collection API/UI exposes password_hash values.

critical.issue: Owner-only DB API returns the users.password_hash field verbatim; the DB Manager document list/editor renders it. This exposes password hashes to the browser and any script/browser extension in the admin session.

ui_bugs.issue: Entering the documented owner credentials Balkin / Dennis123.@@ submits POST /api/admin/login and receives 401, so the visible login gate cannot unlock. The remaining DB Manager UI works when a valid owner token is preloaded.

integration_issues.issue: DbManager.jsx uses the legacy /admin/login route, whose ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASS defaults (Balkin99/Armin1234) are independent from the seeded owner dashboard credentials. The page copy promises owner credentials, but the route rejects them.
Search results and the JSON editor include password_hash. The reproduced DOM showed the bcrypt hash for testbugfix1.

action_items: Make /db-manager authenticate the documented seeded owner account, preferably through /api/admin/login-with-account with captcha or an authenticated owner session exchange; do not keep a second divergent owner password path.
Redact sensitive fields such as password_hash from dbadmin responses and UI editors. Use an explicit denylist at minimum and preferably per-collection projections/schemas.
Retest the DB Manager credential gate and users collection after both fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: DbManager.jsx:44 calls /admin/login, while server.py:33-34 defaults ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASS to Balkin99/Armin1234 and backend/.env defines only OWNER_USERNAME/OWNER_PASSWORD. This directly causes the reproduced 401 with Balkin/Dennis123.@@.

server.py:4063 _dbadmin_sanitize only JSON-serializes records and does not remove secrets; dbadmin_list_docs returns full documents, including users.password_hash. Never expose credential hashes to browser-based generic data tools.
server.py (7,907 lines), Admin.jsx (6,438 lines), and ClientDashboard.jsx (4,605 lines) remain far above the 700-line maintainability threshold and should be split into routers/components.

Discord activity persistence occurs before bot_manager.set_activity. Thus the expected 409 while stopped still changes saved_activity_text to Testing; consider whether a failed Set action should mutate saved configuration.

Client Auto-Live duration uses a native select, and the browser logged invalid option/span hydration markup in the instrumented preview. Prefer the project UI Select component and valid option text nodes.

success_rate.frontend: 90% of requested focused flows passed; DB Manager login gate and password-hash redaction failed

seed_data_creation: Created uniquely named underpaid transaction/admin alerts, dismiss alert, scratch docs, one unsigned webhook event, and one UI alert. All test documents and generated bonus transaction were cleaned. Discord banned words/activity were restored; the real bot was never started. No Auto-Live subscription or SMM order was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run only test_iteration_40_admin_db_discord.py. Backend is healthy: partial credit persisted approved amount=93, partial_credit=true, +65.10 bonus and resolved alert; dismiss second call 404; DB CRUD/delete guard; Discord stopped behavior; unsigned NOWPayments 401; TikTok @tiktok false all passed. UI admin alerts, Discord tab, token-authenticated DB browse/search/edit-cancel, and Auto-Live copy passed. Recheck DB Manager form using Balkin credentials after route alignment, then confirm users docs/editor no longer contain password_hash.
rca_of_the_issue: DB Manager authentication is wired to a legacy, separate in-memory admin credential pair rather than the seeded owner account advertised by the page. Sensitive-data exposure is caused by the generic dbadmin serializer returning all collection fields without a secret-field projection or redaction step.
